description: Grafana activation connection settings and optional verified GPU query defaults. Authentication/readiness does not require a GPU mapping; gpu_utilization requires one here or in its call arguments.

gpu_metric.description: Optional default mapping for gpu_utilization. Configure only after verifying the metric, case-sensitive labels and unit against this datasource. Enables hostname-only calls; explicit action gpu_metric overrides it. If neither supplies a mapping, the action fails with gpu_metric_not_configured (HTTP 400).
